shortlist.story: An AI system aboard an ambulance detected a heart attack before the patient reached hospital, dramatically cutting treatment time.
shortlist.best_title: "AI in an Ambulance Saved a Life"... Heart Attack Detected Before Hospital Arrival, Dramatically Shortening Treatment Time
shortlist.why: A reported real event; AI is the reason the detection happened early; measurable health outcome; plausibly backed by a case report or trial data.

shortlist.story: A person with ALS was able to sing again after AI decoded their brain signals and reconstructed their voice.
shortlist.best_title: ALS Singer Sings Again via Brain Signal AI
shortlist.why: Real outcome for a specific individual; AI decoding brain signals is the reason; high emotional and mass appeal; plausibly a trial or published case study.

shortlist.story: AI scribe technology deployed in Ontario hospitals is freeing physicians to spend more time with patients.
shortlist.best_title: AI Scribe Technology Helps Physicians Spend Time Where it Matters Most
shortlist.why: Present-tense language suggests real deployment, not a plan; AI is the reason; about healthcare delivery rather than the AI industry; hospital association source lends credibility.

shortlist.story: Breast cancer patients rated AI-generated plain-language summaries of Cochrane reviews as just as useful as the originals.
shortlist.best_title: Breast Cancer Patients Rate AI-Generated Summaries Similarly to Original Cochrane Reviews
shortlist.why: Specific participant group; AI is the reason the summaries exist; about patient experience, not the AI industry; Cochrane context suggests peer-reviewed study.

shortlist.story: AI analysis let art conservators discover content that restorers had painted over in a William Merritt Chase work.
shortlist.best_title: How AI Helped Conservators Find What Restorers Erased From a William Merritt Chase Painting
shortlist.why: Named artwork and specific outcome; AI is the tool that made the discovery possible; clearly outside the tech industry; likely a real conservation project with physical evidence.

shortlist.story: AI improved the spatial precision of a visual-cortex implant in one blind patient, though it did not restore sight.
shortlist.best_title: AI Made a Visual-Cortex Implant More Precise in One Blind Man—But It Did Not Restore Sight
shortlist.why: Specific individual, specific measurable outcome honestly reported; AI is the reason for improved precision; likely a lab or early-trial report.

shortlist.story: Seoul National University's STARLINC AI tool successfully removes Starlink satellite trails from telescope observation data.
shortlist.best_title: SNU's STARLINC AI Filters SpaceX Starlink Trails from Telescope Data
shortlist.why: Named tool and institution; a real result that solves a recognised astronomy problem; AI is the reason; outside the AI industry; likely a published study.

shortlist.story: An AI system can now decipher what someone is saying by reading their lip movements alone, with no audio input.
shortlist.best_title: AI Deciphers Speech Through Lip Movements Alone
shortlist.why: Specific capability result; AI is the reason; potential benefit for deaf or speech-impaired people; likely a study or demonstration with evidence.

shortlist.story: A Virginia congressional representative addressed Congress using an AI-generated voice, apparently because of a medical condition.
shortlist.best_title: Virginia representative addresses Congress using AI voice
shortlist.why: Real named event in a real place; AI enabled political participation that might otherwise be impossible; strong accessibility and human-interest angle.

shortlist.story: AI analysis of facial features has identified new markers linked to health conditions, revealing clues not previously detectable from the face.
shortlist.best_title: What can your face reveal about your health? AI finds new clues
shortlist.why: Suggests a study result; AI is the reason for the discovery; about health outside the AI industry; Earth.com typically reports published science.

shortlist.story: An AI-integrated multi-omics pipeline has accelerated breeding of cotton varieties that can withstand climate stress.
shortlist.best_title: Integrated Multi-Omics and Artificial Intelligence Pipeline Accelerates Climate-Resilient Cotton Breeding
shortlist.why: Specific agricultural and climate result; AI is the reason for the acceleration; outside the AI industry; Bioengineer.org typically covers published research.

shortlist.story: Combining aerial drones with AI, researchers can now accurately identify when cattle in feedlots are ready for harvest, reducing guesswork.
shortlist.best_title: Aerial Drones and Artificial Intelligence Identify Optimal Cattle Slaughter Timing in Feedlots
shortlist.why: Specific agricultural application with a measurable outcome; AI is part of the reason; outside the tech industry; likely a study or field trial.

shortlist.story: AI cheating on South Korea's high-stakes university and professional exams is widely reported; a top-scorer publicly confessed and South Korea is now deploying radio-wave detectors to catch cheaters.
shortlist.best_title: South Korea to Deploy Radio-Wave Detectors to Catch AI Exam Cheating Early Next Year, but On-Device AI Remains a Blind Spot
shortlist.why: Widely covered bad-news story; no physical injury to any person; has both an owning-up element (public confession by a top-scorer) and a system-is-responding element (detector deployment announced); each is a separate sourced fact; the line admits the harm before adding the response.
